A Fast Start for the Visitors OH Leuven wasted no time in asserting their dominance away from home. Just 10 minutes into the match, Abdoul Karim Traore found the back of the net following a clever assist from Sory Kaba . The visitors doubled their lead shortly after in the 15th minute, as Traore turned provider for Wouter George , who finished calmly to put his side firmly in control. Westerlo struggled to find their rhythm early on, but they managed to claw their way back into the contest before the break. In the 41st minute, Kyan Vaesen capitalized on a pass from Oscar Gil to reduce the deficit and change the complexion of the game heading into halftime. Their persistence paid off in the 50th minute when Allahyar Sayyadmanesh leveled the score, assisted by Bryan Reynolds . The excitement continued as OH Leuven responded almost immediately; Isa Sakamoto restored the visitors' lead in the 53rd minute. However, the drama was far from over. In the 68th minute, Westerlo was awarded a penalty, which Allahyar Sayyadmanesh expertly converted to secure his brace and bring the scores level once again. Late Tension and Tactical Chess As the clock ticked down, the match grew increasingly physical, leading to a flurry of bookings. Shunsuke Saito , Oscar Gil , and Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi all saw yellow as challenges flew in. Both managers utilized their benches extensively to find a late winner, with the likes of Serhiy Sydorchuk and Youssef Maziz entering the fray. Despite the late pressure from both ends, the defenses held firm. The match concluded in a hard-fought draw, leaving both teams with a point after an enthralling display of footballing spirit.
